check.title: Function resolved source archive has no detected secrets
check.remediation: Remove credential literals from the function source archive and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use authorized runtime secret references instead of embedding credentials.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the function’s resolved source archive.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential or inspect deployed code.

primary_docs.title: function_source
primary_docs.supports: BuildConfig source locates input; sourceProvenance is fixed, resolvedStorageSource resolves generations; omitted source generation selects latest. StorageSource text specifies tar.gz; a source reference does not certify deployed image equivalence.

primary_docs.title: upload_semantics
primary_docs.supports: Upload documentation accepts ZIP and returned StorageSource generation defaults to zero before upload. This is schema research only; no generateUploadUrl or signed URL request is made.

primary_docs.title: function_list
primary_docs.supports: Native list includes Function resources, nextPageToken and unreachable locations. Complete collection required before any archive content read.

primary_docs.title: object_get
primary_docs.supports: GET metadata or alt=media, fixed generation and ifGenerationMatch precondition; storage.objects.get authorization. Uses existing bounded native reader.

primary_docs.title: object_versions
primary_docs.supports: Object generations identify versions; overwrites do not justify reading latest as the collected resolved generation.

claim: Only supported text members of the immutable archive identified by the observed Function resolvedStorageSource. No deployed image, running revision, full code, history, runtime value or freshness equivalence.

actual_producer.source: Actual GCPCollector.scope_jobs Functions v2 unmasked full list and existing IAM hydration; original native response projection before Transport cache/sanitize. Project is real CRM v3 name=projects/{number}; bucket list supplies native projectNumber.
actual_producer.binding: Exact selected project scope and full Function name; configured bucket/object must match resolved provenance, configured generation must be omitted, documented upload placeholder zero, or exact resolved generation. Other shapes UNKNOWN.
actual_producer.reference: Removed buildConfig.source/sourceProvenance receive nested UNKNOWN coverage with static function_source_reference_not_retained; no omission implies an absent setting. FunctionSourceArchiveReference replaces native source alternatives only for opted-in named inventory; archive/object identities and bucket name hash are opaque, with generation/format/updateTime and actual Function owner retained.
actual_producer.private_plan: Bounded private raw target plan is never returned, persisted or cached. It is consumed/cleared per scope; projection failures clear it; root Transport.close cleanup hook included for interrupted runs.
actual_producer.archive_facade: Private options projection after source proof enables only existing gcs_selected_archive for exactly one immutable target. Caller options/kinds are unchanged. Existing objects._bound_bucket, metadata/media streaming, archive parser, scan_content and shared value fingerprint merge are reused without global patches or duplicate network/parsing logic.

required: complete native function/project/bucket collections and source receipts
authorization.default: No extra function GET or archive HTTP calls by default; existing metadata production remains unchanged unless named opt-in is active.

bounds.transport: Existing shared max_calls/global deadline/cancel plus selected-object/archive shared counters and locks; no hard real-time guarantee.

supported: Strict UTF8 regular text in ZIP/tar/tar.gz or tgz suffix with exact native supported MIME and generation metadata/media identity.
Omitted configured generation or documented upload zero can resolve only through mandatory positive native provenance generation.
unknown: empty function collection or no regular text members
expired private plan, cancellation, native call/media/tool failures
cross-project bucket, missing source receipt, wrong media generation/MIME/length/encoding, redirect or truncation

consumer: Requires exact source/own collection membership, same native owner and projected relationship, unchanged Function state/environment/updateTime, successful matching Functions native source receipt, real project/bucket ownership receipts, both exact object metadata/media receipts for the opaque object identity, and audited complete archive dual-tool coverage. Contradictions stay UNKNOWN.
native_schema_gap: Function StorageSource schema describes tar.gz, while v2 upload method explicitly describes ZIP. Both supported archive formats are scanned only as referenced bytes; this difference is recorded rather than treated as proof of deployment format or deployed-code equivalence.
composition: Root-owned environment helper permits independently removed free-text coverage and exact removed source/sourceProvenance coverage only inside buildConfig, retaining strict required environment/service/build-parent coverage. Directed native both-selected positives and 11-function single-/multi-page coexistence prove source bounds do not poison ordinary metadata/environment results.

actual_tools.positive: Pinned dual-tool synthetic native archive positive: same literal in two text members and two native Function owners; one exact-value deduplicated finding, owners retained.
actual_tools.negative: Pinned dual-tool ZIP/tar/tar.gz supported-text negatives only.
actual_tools.privacy: Tests exclude raw object path containing synthetic detected literal, archive filenames, raw payloads, auth and free-text metadata from cache/evidence/envelopes/scanner cache/output. Pending target plan is gone after consumption.

runtime_cases.pipeline: Native mocked HTTP -> actual CRM/bucket/Functions producers -> installed native pre-cache hook -> exact trusted archive facade -> audited native GCS metadata/media reader -> real pinned dual tools -> actual native envelopes -> sealed snapshot/resources/engine._index/MemoIndex -> pure callback.

known_unproved_branches: Root installed source capture/dependent/close hooks, supported/default-excluded inventory, exact named mapping and selection metadata during review; focused tests exercise actual GCPCollector/Transport without injection. Root reported registry import installed; final canonical admission remains root-owned and is not certified by this worker.
No live API permissions, storage authorization, actual provider deployment, project alias equivalence, regional reachability or cloud quota behavior was exercised.
Configured and resolved bucket/object differences are conservatively UNKNOWN even if a provider copy/normalization could explain them.

Only ACTIVE GEN_2 Functions with exact original project-name binding and resolved immutable same-project storage archives are supported. No repo/git/signed upload source resolution or deployed container inspection.
Archived objects may be absent/deleted/denied; no retry to latest or other bucket is allowed.

Native function owner/project/bucket identities remain metadata for triage. Arbitrary secrets or encodings embedded in native identity fields are not universally certified absent; archive object/member names are opaque.
Source and media reads are not atomic with deployment changes; result belongs to collected resolved generation and updateTime, not current deployed compliance.
Existing audited reader rejects unsupported MIME/encryption/compression, binary and nested members; this limits PASS to a completely supported archive.
Ordinary Functions native JSON decoding uses the existing GCP Transport response.json path; duplicate JSON object key detection before that parser is not newly certified.
Global cancellation and cooperative CPU/process/network deadlines are bounded by existing machinery, not a hard real-time scheduling guarantee.
Pattern completeness, arbitrary encoding detection and credential usability are unproved; no credential validation runs.
